biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of stone and earth. The berserking frenzy of earthen disasters.

Defense

AC 38, touch 12, flat-footed 34 (+26 natural, +4 dex, -2 size)

hp 703 [912] (19d12+228)

mp 122

Fort +24, Ref +15, Will +19

Absorb Earth; DR 10/magic;

Immune Ability Drain, Berserk, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Fear, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Sap, Shaken, Sleep, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie;

SR 27; Strong Lightning

Weakness Water and Wind

Offense

Speed 60 ft., burrow 40 ft.

Melee Bite +30 (4d6+22 plus 2d6 earth damage), 2 claws +30 (2d6+15 plus 1d6 earth damage), tail slap +28 (2d6+22 plus 1d6 earth damage)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Abilities 50 Gs

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (100-ft. line, 14d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 30 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Small creatures, DC 30, 2d8+22), Earthquake, Landslide, Magnitude 8

Burst Mode Earthen Rage

Spells Known (FC CL 19th, concentration +25)

0th (DC 16) - Detect Magic, Ignite, Mending, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 17) - Entomb, Stone, Stone Fist

2nd (DC 18) - Binding Earth, Elemental Resistance, Entomb II, Groundswell, Stone II, Stone Call

3rd (DC 19) - Dispel, Entomb III, Meld into Stone, Shifting Sand, Stone III, Stonera, Stone Shape

4th (DC 20) - Comet, Stone IV

5th (DC 21) - Crush, Stonega, Transmute Mud to Rock, Transmute Rock to Mud

6th (DC 22) - Greater Dispel, Mass Binding Earth, Move Earth, Quake, Wall of Stone

7th (DC 23) - Crush II

8th (DC 24) - Earth Rupture, Quake II

9th (DC 25) - Clashing Rocks, Meteor

Statistics

Str 40, Dex 18, Con 32, Int 22, Wis 22, Cha 22

Base Atk +19; CMB +36; CMD 50 (54 vs. trip)

Feats All-Consuming Swing, Cleave, Devastating Strike, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike

Skills Appraise +31, Bluff +31, Climb +39, Diplomacy +31, Heal +31, Intimidate +31, Knowledge (arcana) +31, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +31, Knowledge (local) +31, Perception +31, Sense Motive +31, Stealth +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth

Languages Undercommon, Draconic plus 5 more

SQ Horned Tusk
